title: Cancel Subscription
summary: Allows a user to cancel their active subscription from account settings. Access continues until the end of the billing cycle. Refunds are not provided for unused time.
canonical_answer: To cancel your subscription, go to Account Settings → Billing → Manage Subscription → Cancel Subscription. Only account owners can cancel. Your access will continue until the end of the billing cycle, and no refunds are issued for unused time.

prerequisites.name: user_logged_in
prerequisites.description: User must be authenticated and able to access account settings.

prerequisites.name: account_owner_only
prerequisites.description: Only the account owner is authorized to cancel the subscription.

steps.instruction: Verify the user is logged into their account.
steps.on_fail: Ask the user to log in before proceeding.

steps.instruction: Check if the user is the account owner.
steps.on_fail: Inform the user that only the account owner can cancel the subscription.
steps.expected_outcome: User is authorized to perform cancellation.
Subscription is successfully canceled and confirmation is shown.

decision_rules.if: User is on a trial plan
decision_rules.else: Continue access until the end of billing period

decision_rules.if: User asks for refund after cancellation
decision_rules.then: Inform that refunds are not provided for partially used billing periods

constraints.refund_policy: No refunds are issued for partially used billing periods.
constraints.access_after_cancel: Access continues until the end of the current billing cycle unless on a trial, where access ends immediately.
constraints.data_retention: User data remains available for a limited time after cancellation.

examples.before_human_doc_excerpt: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings.
examples.after_agent_ready_excerpt: Verify user is account owner → Navigate to Billing → Execute cancellation → Apply refund and access policies.
sample_queries: How do I stop my plan?
Will I get a refund if I cancel?
gold_responses: You can cancel from Account Settings → Billing → Manage Subscription.
Only account owners can cancel subscriptions.
No refunds are issued, but access continues until the end of billing period.
